Title: IMemoryService — Memory Update, Merge & Duplicate Detection
Summary: Documents the new IMemoryService methods for updating facts, merging entries, and finding potential duplicate memories.
Content:
## IMemoryService — Update, Merge & Duplicate Detection

### New Methods (added alongside existing CRUD and Search)

#### `Task UpdateFactAsync(string entryId, string factId, MemoryFact updatedFact, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Replaces an existing fact within an entry. The fact is identified by `factId`. The `updatedFact` provides the new `FactType` and property dictionary. Throws `ArgumentException` if entry or fact not found.

#### `Task RemoveFactAsync(string entryId, string factId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Removes a specific fact from an entry by `factId`. Silently succeeds if the fact doesn't exist. Throws `ArgumentException` if the entry is not found.

#### `Task<Entry> MergeEntriesAsync(string targetEntryId, string sourceEntryId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Merges two entries into one. The **target** keeps its ID; the **source** is deleted.

**Merge behavior:**
- All facts from source are appended to target's fact list
- Keywords are unioned (case-insensitive)
- Title: the longer of the two wins
- Description: if source has a description not already contained in target's, it's appended with ` | ` separator
- Source entry is deleted from the store

Throws `ArgumentException` if either entry not found, or if target == source.

#### `Task<IEnumerable<(Entry EntryA, Entry EntryB, double Similarity)>> FindPotentialDuplicatesAsync(string? categoryId = null, double minSimilarity = 0.6, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)`
Finds pairs of entries that may represent duplicate information.

**Parameters:**
- `categoryId` — optional filter to only search within one category
- `minSimilarity` — threshold (0–1) below which pairs are excluded. Default: 0.6

**Similarity calculation:**
- Keyword overlap (Jaccard): 40% weight
- Title word overlap (Jaccard, words >2 chars): 35% weight
- Fact type overlap (Jaccard): 25% weight

**Behavior:**
- Only compares entries within the same category
- Decayed entries are filtered out before comparison
- Returns pairs ordered by similarity descending

### Usage Pattern

```csharp
// Update a fact
await memoryService.UpdateFactAsync(entryId, factId, new MemoryFact
{
    FactType = "preference",
    _properties = new() { ["subject"] = "theme", ["value"] = "dark" }
});

// Merge two duplicate memories
var merged = await memoryService.MergeEntriesAsync(targetId, sourceId);

// Find duplicates in a category
var dups = await memoryService.FindPotentialDuplicatesAsync(categoryId: catId, minSimilarity: 0.7);
foreach (var (a, b, sim) in dups)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{sim:P0} similar: {a.Title} ↔ {b.Title}");
}
```
